thread:
maria: Heads up — `npm audit` flagged a couple high/critical advisories in console/ui after the `main` merge. Quick triage please.
samir: can you paste the list? severity + package? :eyes:
maria: Sure, pasted from `npm audit --json` quick output:
```
{
  "advisories": {
    "1548": { "module_name": "serialize-javascript", "severity": "high", "cves": ["CVE-2022-1234"] },
    "2021": { "module_name": "lodash.merge", "severity": "moderate", "cves": ["CVE-2023-5678"] },
    "1870": { "module_name": "debug", "severity": "low" }
  }
}
```
maria: The two that worry me are serialize-javascript (used by our SSR bundle pipeline) and a transitive lodash.merge via some old charting lib.
jade: are those prod dependencies or only dev/build-time transitive ones? big difference for rollback strategy.
maria: serialize-javascript is bundled into the server-side render build (so affects prod). lodash.merge is only used in an internal dev-only util in the console but comes in as transitive from `@charting/legacy` which is a prod dep.
kevin: do we have a fix available upstream? patch versions? :thinking:
maria: upstream released patched serialize-javascript@6.0.1 and lodash.merge has a 4.x patch. but both require bumping a couple top-level deps (webpack/terser for serialize case, and charting lib needs a rev).
samir: please avoid `npm audit fix --force` — that often causes lockfile churn and surprises. prefer explicit bumps or `overrides` in package.json so we control the change.
jade: overrides are supported on our npm version? we run npm 8.x in CI so `overrides` should work. downside: hides real dependency mismatch; prefer bumping direct deps when possible.
kevin: CI note: last time we bumped webpack it changed `package-lock.json` by ~420 lines and caused one flaky visual test in Circle. we should allocate time to fix snapshots.
maria: plan proposal:
- open PR to bump `webpack`/`terser` to versions that pull in serialize-javascript patched. run bundle and smoke test locally.
- open PR to bump `@charting/legacy` or patch with override for `lodash.merge` until charting team releases.
- include explicit `overrides` and a short note in PR explaining why (CVE ids + link to audit output).
- run full e2e and static type checks; schedule deploy during off-peak window.
kevin: agree. add `security-bot` checklist: automated audit in CI, e2e, local bundle size check, visual snapshots.
samir: also add a short postmortem entry in the vuln tracker with CVE numbers and affected versions.
jade: who will own the webpack PR? I can take the charting override PR if someone else takes webpack.
maria: i'll take webpack/terser PR and run bundle tests. jade pls own charting override. kevin pls coordinate release window and make a canary build to smoke prod.
security-bot: Automated note: new advisory created in vuln-tracker (#VULN-2026-014). Patch recommended: serialize-javascript >=6.0.1, lodash.merge >=4.3.2.
dependabot: I opened PR #431: "bump serialize-javascript to 6.0.1" (depends on webpack bump). :robot_face:
kevin: cool. for lockfile churn, add a release note and mention snapshots may need update. run `yarn why`? we use npm but `npm ls` will do.
jade: also prefer to add a tiny integration test that hits SSR path for console home so we catch regressions earlier.
maria: will add test and reference in PR. timeline: PRs today, CI green tomorrow, plan deploy Thursday 02:00 UTC if no issues. objections?
samir: :thumbsup:
kevin: :shipit:
maria: thanks team — I'll link PRs here when created.
maria: (later) PRs opened: #987 (webpack/terser bump + bundle smoke), #988 (overrides for lodash.merge).
